entries.def: (= increase the volume; opp turn it down)
(= change to a different channel; e.g. from 1 to 3)
a programme often on two or three times a week, which follows the lives of a group/community of people. The stories are often exciting, dramatic and hard to believe.
individuals or teams (called contestants) answer questions or play different games against each other.
entries.example: The winner gets a prize, e.g. money or a holiday.

entries.def: a programme where a presenter talks to famous people about their lives.
a film with factual information, often about a problem in society.
a number of programmes about the same situation or the same characters in different situations.
(= programmes that try to be funny)
(= programmes with interesting characters and exciting situations)
programmes about a social or political problem. Current means happening 'now/at the present time'.
(= what programmes are showing on TV tonight?)
(= what time is the film showing?)
(= parts of the game after it has been played, e.g. later in the day/evening)
(= the programme has been on TV before)
entries.example: 'Friends' is on tonight, but it's a repeat. I've seen it.
